title: BulbaSwap V3 (Morph L2) — byte-identical Uniswap V3 fork; no unprivileged extraction
closed_reasons: Factory runtime bytecode differs from canonical Uniswap V3 factory 0x1F98431c8aD98523631AE4a59f267346ea31F984 in exactly 20 bytes, all inside the embedded factory-address literal -> canonical code

Pool init code embedded in the factory creation bytecode hashes to 0xe34f199b19b2b4f47f68442619d555527d244f78a3297ea89325f843f87b8b54 == canonical v3-core v1.0.0 POOL_INIT_CODE_HASH -> all 212 pools are byte-identical canonical UniswapV3Pool
NonfungiblePositionManager / SwapRouter02 / V3Migrator runtime bytecode byte-identical to canonical Ethereum-mainnet deployments except 20-byte immutable address slots
UniswapV3Staker verified source byte-for-byte identical to Uniswap/v3-staker@main (only optimizer-runs setting differs)
NPM.collect / decreaseLiquidity / burn all revert 'Not approved' for a foreign position (fork-verified)
flash() requires full repayment (+fee) and reentrancy from the flash callback is blocked by the pool lock (fork-verified)
skim() does not exist in v3-core v1.0.0: selector 0xbc25cf77 absent from deployed pool code (fork-verified)
collectProtocol / setFeeProtocol / factory setOwner / enableFeeAmount all owner-gated (owner = GnosisSafeProxy 0x9876097201662D70A63C935c2f7576B35D6f45e7)
Public sweep primitives (NPM/Router sweepToken, unwrapWETH9, refundETH) exist but every periphery token+ETH balance is 0
BulbaSwapPointsRedemption.claim() requires an ECDSA signature from a live globalSigner; all withdrawals are onlyOwner
observationCardinality == 1 on all 212 pools -> no TWAP oracle; increaseObservationCardinalityNext is permissionless but yields no value

BulbaSwap V2 router 0x81606e6f8aad6c75c2f383ea595c2b9f8ce8ae3a permanently holds 13096433.04 MOOD (stuck, S); canonical UniswapV2Router02 has no sweep/rescue

caveats: MOOD price (~$0.001032) is derived from a V2 pair holding only 0.000756 WETH -> low confidence; the stuck MOOD is therefore NOT included in the S category number
Prices are DefiLlama spot (coins.llama.fi) at measurement time; block pinned at 28699967
protocolFees read via eth_getStorageAt slot 3 (canonical UniswapV3Pool layout), cross-checked against slot0.feeProtocol
Position enumeration is point-in-time; 0 rows were dropped, ids with liquidity 0 are burned/empty positions
Verdict holds for the CURRENT deployed bytecode; it would change only if the factory owner Safe or the PointsRedemption ProxyAdmin deployed new non-canonical logic
This finding was assessed read-only; no mainnet transaction was sent; all PoC execution was on a Morph fork at a pinned block
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0.00 live: the BulbaSwap V3 factory, all 212 pools, the NPM, SwapRouter02, V3Migrator and the UniswapV3Staker are byte-for-byte canonical Uniswap V3 (pool init-code hash == canonical POOL_INIT_CODE_HASH), so collect/flash/skim/auth paths are all closed; the only live value is $8.94M of user-owned LP principal (H-O), $17.6k of owner-only protocol fees (P) and ~$19 of permanently stuck dust (S).
